info.title: RegFox Universal API
info.description: RegFox is an event registration and ticketing platform for forms, orders, registrants, tickets, subscriptions, customers, memberships, coupons, inventory, and webhooks.

put.description: Checks in a registrant in the RegFox account.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

id.description: Unique ID of the registrant that was checked in.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.
